rows.grounds: numeral element forming the count eighty-four
past passive participle describing those subjected to suffering

items.question: What is the extent and locus of torment experienced within the cycle of birth?
premises: These thousands are womb-mechanisms or generative devices.
Beings are tormented within these womb-mechanisms.
items.inference: Torment pervades an immense multiplicity of generative loci in the cycle of birth.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
